claim_boundary: Tool availability proves that commands are reachable.  It is not kernel synthesis, timing, area, implementation, or PPA evidence.
probe_policy: Try local `ic` first; if it is missing or does not prove all required tools reachable, fall back to SSH target.  Both paths source ~/.bashrc and run `which` plus the tool version probe.

ic <<'EOS'

EOS
